components.text: To recharge a dun Cleansegleam, activate the gem while you have a bucket of milk in your inventory. The milk is conusmed, and the bucket is returned. Alternatively, if you have a $(l:arcanearchives:items/radiantamphora)Radiant Amphora$(/l) linked to a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radianttank)Radiant Tank$(/l) containing milk, the milk is deducted from the tank directly.
